rows.author: A010
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING THE EXEMPTION OF THE JUDICIARY AND ITS PERSONNEL FOR THE COVERAGE OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6758, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE SALARY STANDARDIZATION LAW
rows.abstract: Rationale: Judges of 2nd level courts receive P41,960.33, while judges of the first level court receive P33,599 monthly salary, that is before taxes. Considering today's high cost of living,their monthly salaries are not enough. Furthermore, corporations are offering new lawyers with a starting salary almost equal to the salary of a judge.  A private practitioner can even make in a week what an MTC judge is earning in a month. Thus , it is not surprising that very a few opt for a career in thejudiciary and the difficulty of enticing an established practitioner from leaving his financially rewarding occupation. It is in this trying times that a solution must be formulated.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 2000-08-07

rows.author: A049
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE FIELD OF LAND TITLE INSURANCE AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 612, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE INSURANCE CODE OF 1978 AS AMENDED BY PRESIDENTIAL DECREES 1455 AND 1460 AND BATAS PAMBANSA BLG. 874
rows.abstract: Rationale: TITLE INSURANCE protects whoever is dealing with the land titles fron any losses which he may incur should the title later on turn out to be fraudulent  or a fake.  Title insurance will give confidence to financial institutions and individual persons to proceed and deal with real property, knowing, that should it later turn out that the title sold or mortgaged was a fake, the financial institution or the individual will be reimbursed by the insurance company for the losses. There will no longer be any need for thorough, time-consuming and expensive research on the origins of the title, as the title insurance company will do it for you. A computerized data bank on all relevant information concerning a piece of property and the tiitle it represents shall be kept and maintained by the title insurance company for use by the general public, without cost to the government.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2000-08-14

rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE MANDATORY LABELING OF FOOD AND FOOD PRODUCTS CONTAINING GENETICALLY-MOD IFIED ORGANISMS AND FOOD PRODUCED BY GENETIC ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGIES, AMENDING FOR THAT PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED THREE THOUSAND SEVEN HUNDRED AND TWENTY, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE FOOD, DRUGS AND DRUG DEVICES AND COSMETICS ACT AND REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED SEVEN THOUSAND THREE HUNDRED AND NINETY-FOUR, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE CONSUMERS' ACT OF THE PHILIPPINES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Genetically Engineered Food Right to Known Act." All food and food products domestically sold, whether manufactured locally or imported, and which contain genetically modified organisms, including those produced by genetic engineering technologies,shall be properly identified in their respective labels of packaging with the following: (1) A notice as follows: "GENETICALLY ENGINEERED"; (2) A notice as follows: "GOVERNMENT NOTICE: THIS PRODUCT CONTAINS A GENETICALLY ENGINEERED MATERIAL, OR WASPRODUCED WITH A GENETICALLY ENGINEERED MATERIAL".

rows.author: A073
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO REQUIRE ALL VOTERS TO FILE AN INCOME TAX RETURN, MAKING THE FILING THEREOF AS A PRECONDITION FOR VOTING
rows.abstract: "The Tax Filer - Voter Act of 2000." Rationale: In order to strengthen the existing electoral system and to further equip our elected officials with the capacity to effectively discharge the affairs of state, there is need to introduce electoral reforms.  One such reform is the granting of the privilege to vote only to individuals who are bona-fide filers of income tax returns - in addition to the current requirements of qualified voters.  This, of course, doe not mean that only taxpayers shallbe allowed to vote.  Even thos who need not pay taxes may vote so long as they have filed the appropriate income tax returns.
rows.status: Substituted by HB12804

rows.author: A073
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING THE MANGO AS THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL FRUIT
rows.abstract: Rationale:  As a commodity of commercial value in the Philippines, the mango is extensively planted in different regions of the country.  In 1999, the Bureau of Agricultural Statistics reported that the total area planted to this crop was estimatedat 113,562 hectares, a 21% increase from 1998. The average increase in farm area was registered at 9%. >  World demand for mango has also been increasing exhibiting an average growth rate of 8% annually for the period of 1996 to 1998. In 1998, the mango buyers in the world imported around 457,000 metric tons as reported by the Food and Agriculture Organization. Of the total world production, the Philippines ranks 5th, together with Pakistan, accounting for about 4% of the world production.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2000-08-16

rows.author: A006
rows.title_full: AN ACT AUTHORIZING PRESIDENT JOSEPH EJERCITO ESTRADA TO EXERCISE LIMITED SPECIAL POWERS NECESSARY AND PROPER FOR THE REHABILITATION AND DEVELOPMENT OF MINDANAO AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "MINDANAO CRISIS ACT OF 2000."  It is the policy of the State to adopt suitable and sufficient measures to fast track and establish a firm legal foundation for the rehabilitation and development of Mindanao, in the light of the socio-economic crisisand peace and order situation prevailing on the whole island.  In realtion thereto, there shall be a full integration of all rehabilitation and development plans and programs of homogeneous co-related growth areas in accordance with the individual need and comparative advantage of each growth area in the whole of Mindanao. > To cope with the crisis, and consistent with SAection 23 (2) Article VI of the 1987 Constitution, there is an urgent need to grant the President limited and specific powerss to restore peace and order, and to achieve propserity for the general welfare, and the for the greatest  good of the greatest number of the inhabitants of Mindanao.
rows.status: Substituted by HB11833
